verdict.rationale: A LiteLLM maintainer confirmed the proxy supports streaming the same way the openai-python SDK does. First-party docs show a unified completion() interface and OpenAI-format responses across providers, which implies streaming works uniformly, but no first-party doc in the pack describes streaming itself. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of streaming through the gateway, evidence that token-by-token streaming works for every provider (chunk normalization), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream token-by-token responses through the gateway from any provider

citations.quote: LiteLLM maintainer confirmed proxy supports streaming and function-calling in the same way as the openai-python SDK
Call any provider using the same completion() interface, with no API to re-learn for each one
Every response follows the OpenAI Chat Completions format, regardless of provider.
